name: Select
summary: Progressively enhanced single-choice field with validation variants, associated feedback, a custom trigger and listbox, native form fallback, and complete keyboard behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Relative wrapper that owns the label, native fallback, custom trigger, and anchored listbox.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible label associated with the enhanced trigger.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the label text when the native select is required.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Positioning context that groups the native field, enhanced trigger, and anchored listbox.

anatomy.name: nativeField
anatomy.description: Original native select marked as the hidden form and fallback control after enhancement succeeds.

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: Button that displays the current value and controls the custom listbox.

anatomy.name: value
anatomy.description: Current selected option label rendered inside the trigger.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Optional supporting or validation message associated with the native field and enhanced trigger.

anatomy.name: listbox
anatomy.description: Custom popup surface anchored below the trigger with an eight-pixel gap.

anatomy.name: option
anatomy.description: Custom listbox option generated from one native option.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Decorative SVG indicator rendered at the trailing edge of the trigger.

anatomy.name: optionCheck
anatomy.description: Decorative SVG check shown only beside the selected option.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Validation error state with error label, border, message, indicator, and focus ring.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Successful validation state with success label, border, message, indicator, and focus ring.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Validation warning state with warning label, border, message, indicator, and focus ring.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default select size aligned with the default Input field.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state on an available fallback field or enhanced trigger; validation variants retain their semantic border family.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator with the shared field focus-ring hierarchy; the independently selected variant determines the color family.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable native field and enhanced trigger state.

states.name: open
states.description: Expanded trigger state with the listbox visible below the field.

states.name: optionHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on an available option.

states.name: optionSelected
states.description: Option synchronized with the current native select value.

states.name: optionDisabled
states.description: Unavailable option skipped by pointer and keyboard selection.

behavior.name: progressiveEnhancement
behavior.description: The native select remains visible and functional without JavaScript. Enhancement hides it only after the custom trigger and listbox are ready; multiple, size-greater-than-one, and optgroup content remain native because the custom popup is a flat single-choice contract.

behavior.name: nativeComplexChoiceFallback
behavior.description: Multiple-selection, listbox-sized, and grouped native selects are deliberately not enhanced, preserving native semantics instead of flattening unsupported choice structures.

behavior.name: labelAssociation
behavior.description: The visible label names and activates the enhanced trigger.

behavior.name: messageAssociation
behavior.description: Supporting and validation feedback is programmatically associated with both the form value owner and the visible trigger.

behavior.name: errorSemantics
attributes: role="alert" on a dynamically presented error message
behavior.description: The error class provides visual treatment while native and enhanced controls expose invalid state and corrective feedback semantics.

behavior.name: triggerRelationship
behavior.description: The trigger exposes expanded state, references the listbox, and identifies the keyboard-highlighted option while focus remains on the trigger.

behavior.name: nativeFormOwnership
behavior.description: The native select remains the sole value, validity, reset, and form-submission owner; the enhanced trigger reflects required semantics, the label mirrors them with a decorative centered marker, and no competing value state is emitted.

behavior.name: listboxSemantics
behavior.description: The popup and generated options expose single-select listbox semantics.

behavior.name: placeholderPrompt
attributes: hidden on the empty-value placeholder option
behavior.description: An initial placeholder may label the closed trigger through a hidden empty-value native option, but it is not exposed as a disabled listbox choice.

behavior.name: selectionSynchronization
behavior.description: Selecting a custom option updates the native value, selected label, aria-selected states, and dispatches native input and change events.

behavior.name: keyboardNavigation
behavior.description: Keyboard interaction opens, navigates, selects, dismisses, and performs prefix matching while skipping disabled options.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The listbox closes after Escape, Tab, outside interaction, selection, or repeated trigger activation without moving focus into the popup.

behavior.name: nativeDisabled
behavior.description: The native disabled state synchronizes to the trigger, and disabled options are exposed and skipped without becoming selectable.

behavior.name: motionPreference
behavior.description: Reduced-motion mode removes field transitions and the decorative indicator rotation without hiding state or content.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible label associated with the enhanced trigger and listbox.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Optional supporting or validation message associated with the Select.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation selected from the canonical variant list; default is the contract default.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes both the native fallback and enhanced trigger unavailable.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native form field name used for successful form submission.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Participates in native constraint validation, is reflected to the enhanced combobox trigger, and shows a decorative centered asterisk beside the label.

accessibility: Preserve the native select as the no-JavaScript fallback and form value owner.
Associate the visible label with the enhanced trigger and reference it from the listbox.
Connect supporting and validation messages to both the native field and enhanced trigger with aria-describedby.
Use aria-invalid="true" on both native and enhanced controls for the error variant; do not apply aria-invalid for success or warning.
Do not rely on validation color or the indicator alone; include associated feedback text.
Expose aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant on the trigger.
Expose the enhanced trigger as a select-only combobox, reflect native required state with aria-required, and keep the decorative label marker synchronized without adding it to the accessible name.
Expose role=listbox, role=option, aria-selected, and aria-disabled on the custom popup and options.
Keep an initial placeholder out of the option panel with a hidden empty-value native option; do not represent it as a disabled listbox choice.
Keep DOM focus on the trigger while arrow keys update the highlighted option.
Support ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape, Tab, and typeahead behavior.
Close on outside interaction and synchronize custom selection back to the native field.

Keep the native select as the only owner of name, selected value, constraint validation, reset, and form submission; controlled target adapters update that native owner and consume native input and change events.
Use Combobox instead when the list requires search, filtering, asynchronous results, or free-form input.

web.notes: Canonical CSS styles the fallback and enhanced UI; components/js/theme.js generates and synchronizes the custom listbox.

shopify.notes: Shopify renders native select markup and the shared theme.js progressively enhances it without changing submitted values.
